intervals.quote: Construction was completed in January 1954 and the new machine, a synchrotron designed to accelerate protons up to energies of 6.5 billion electron volts, then designated BeV (now universally known as GeV), was christened the “Bevatron.”

summary.plain: A proton accelerator at Berkeley, California, completed in 1954 and built with an energy just above what is needed to make an antiproton. In 1955 it did, and it ran until 1993.
summary.technical: Proton synchrotron designed for 6.5 GeV (then written 6.5 BeV), christened the Bevatron when construction was completed in January 1954; operated 1954-1993 at Berkeley Lab. Site of the 1955 antiproton observation.
